name: Ptah
body:
Known as the Lord of Truth, First of the Gods, and Conceiver of the World, Ptah is the “uncreated”—the deity that existed before anyone or anything. From Ptah, the rest of the gods were created.

Ptah appears as a green-skinned human male with a straight, black beard, wrapped in a form-fitting, white robe. He wears a skullcap and holds a scepter marked with the symbols of power, life, and stability. In acknowledgment of his creator-god status, Ptah is worshiped by artisans of all sorts, including carpenters, shipbuilders, metalworkers, sculptors, architects, stoneworkers, and potters.

Voice

Granted Powers: Your voice is a source of great power. You can use it to punish transgressors, inspire allies, and power your magic. Clerics with the voice domain always use a verbal component to cast a spell, and their verbal component replaces any somatic component typically required. A cleric with this domain can never benefit from the Silent Spell feat.

Explosive Tirade (Sp)

As a standard action, you select one foe within 30 feet and unleash a tirade upon them. The target must make a Fortitude save against the tirade that explodes in its head. On a failed save, the target is deafened for 1 round and takes 1d6 points of sonic damage + 1 point for every 3 cleric levels you possess. The target takes half as much damage on a successful save and is not deafened. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Word of Opposition (Ex)

When a creature within 100 feet of you that you can see or hear begins to cast a spell, you can use an immediate action to speak a word of opposition. The caster must then make a Concentration check (DC = 15 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier).

On a failed check, the spell is wasted. If the check is successful, the spell goes off as normal, but you and any allies within 100 feet of you gain a sacred bonus to any saving throws you must make against the spell equal to 1 + 1 for every five cleric levels you possess (to a maximum of +5 at 20th level). You can use this ability once per day at 8th level and one additional time per day for every four cleric levels beyond 8th.

Domain: 1st-ear-piercing scream, 2ndpiercing shriek, 3rd-agonizing rebuke, 4threbuke, 5th-forbid action, greater, 6th-litany of madness, 7th-resonating word, 8th-shout, greater, 9th-power word kill.
